source.description:
## PROBLEM
Implement the approved enforcement design.
## SUCCESS
Suitable structural searches prefer ast_grep and repeated parse/aggregate loops prefer persistent Python, conditionally when active, with fallbacks and evidence.
## SCOPE
Files authorized by explorer design plus tests/generated assets.
## NON_GOALS
No hard grep/bash ban or ceremonial tool calls.
## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: critical. Global prompt path HIGH risk; report before editing. Preserve activation and permissions.
## LIBRARIES
Reuse installed extensions only.
## VALIDATION
- [ ] Conditional injection tests.
- [ ] Model smoke calls both tools.
- [ ] Simple config/prose grep remains valid.
- [ ] Full QA/security pipeline passes.
## OUTPUT
Commits, behavior examples, evidence, limitations.
source.title: executor: implement bounded Python and ast-grep routing enforcement
